description: A four-slice sample player: a loaded sample is cut into four slices and each trigger plays the next one, every slice having its own speed, direction, gate output and effects loop.

params.text: Sets how fast that slice plays back, and so its pitch.
Scales that slice's Speed CV before it reaches the speed; at the full clockwise setting the CV tracks 1V per octave.
Reverses the direction that slice plays in.
Takes that slice in or out of the rotation, so the mode passes over it.
Sets the fade in and the fade out applied at the two ends of every slice as it plays.
Scales the Fade CV before it reaches the fade time.
Chooses which slice plays next: Forward, Backwards, Ping-Pong, Random or Addressable. Click it to step through the five.
Plays the next slice, as a trigger arriving at the Trigger input does.
Sets where in the sample the four slices are cut.
Scales the Slice Spread CV before it reaches the cut points.
Sets the rotation back, so the next trigger plays the first slice again.

inputs.text: Shifts that slice's playback speed, tracking 1V per octave when that slice's attenuverter is at the full clockwise setting.
A rise above 2V reverses the direction that slice plays in.
A rise above 2V takes that slice in or out of the rotation.
The left side of the audio coming back from that slice's external effect, mixed into the output.
The right side of the audio coming back from that slice's external effect, mixed into the output.
A rise above 2V plays the next slice. In Addressable mode it is read as a level instead, each whole volt from 1V upward picking the slice of that number.
Shifts the fade in and fade out time, scaled by the Fade attenuverter.
Shifts where the sample is cut into slices, scaled by the Slice Spread attenuverter.
A rise above 2V sets the rotation back, so the next trigger plays the first slice again.

outputs.text: The left side of the mix of every slice that is playing.
The right side of the mix of every slice that is playing.
The left side of that slice's audio, to be sent out to an external effect and brought back at that slice's Return.
The right side of that slice's audio, to be sent out to an external effect and brought back at that slice's Return.
High while that slice is playing.

notes: the module is silent until a sample is loaded, from Load Sample on the panel menu, and until a clock or trigger reaches the Trigger input.
a sample plays back at its recorded speed only when Rack is running at the sample rate the file was recorded at.
menu: Load Sample — reads a WAV or AIF/AIFF file into the module.
Save Sample — writes the loaded audio back out as Wav or as Aif/Aiff, without the fade, speed or direction the panel applies.
Clear Sample — empties the module of the audio it holds.
Exclude Direct Sends: No, Yes — No sends every slice to the output mix; Yes keeps out of the mix any slice whose Send is patched and whose Return is not.
